SELECT FROM org_unit o LEFT JOIN org_unit p ON p.id = o.parent_id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0
SELECT FROM org_unit o LEFT JOIN org_unit p ON p.id = o.parent_id WHERE o.code = #{code} AND o.deleted = 0

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO org_unit (code, name, short_name, parent_id, unit_type, region_code, is_kpi_assignable, sort_order, path, level, status, hrm_ref, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{shortName}, #{parentId}, #{unitType}, #{regionCode}, #{isKpiAssignable}, #{sortOrder}, '/', 1, 'HIEU_LUC', #{hrmRef}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE org_unit SET name = #{name}, short_name = #{shortName}, parent_id = #{parentId}, unit_type = #{unitType}, region_code = #{regionCode}, is_kpi_assignable = #{isKpiAssignable}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE org_unit SET path = #{path}, level = #{level} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE org_unit SET path = CONCAT(#{newPrefix}, SUBSTRING(path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldPrefix}) + 1)), level = level + #{levelDelta} WHERE path LIKE CONCAT(#{oldPrefix}, '%') AND path <> #{oldPrefix}
UPDATE org_unit SET deleted = 1, updated_by = #{by}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM org_unit WHERE parent_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) AS children, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE org_unit_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) AS users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kpi_assignment_detail WHERE org_unit_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) AS assignments, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_result WHERE org_unit_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) AS evaluations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kpi WHERE deleted = 0 AND (assigning_unit_id = #{id} OR evaluating_unit_id = #{id})) AS kpis, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM strategy WHERE org_unit_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0) AS strategies
